comparison.objective: Inspect and report engine-oil level using a pull–wipe–reseat–reread procedure; candidate separates ceramic media from washers in a screen.
comparison.physical_skill: Dipstick extraction, rag wiping, reinsertion and visual classification versus bimanual screen lifting, agitation and size-selective aperture passage.
comparison.success_condition: Correct oil-level report with cleaned/reseated dipstick and released tools versus ≥98% media recovery, total washer retention, supported screen reseating, release and 3-second dwell. No material rubric details are missing.
comparison.reason: The record tests procedural inspection and wiping of one slender instrument, not selective many-body separation through a sieve.
